cover_metadata.cover_rule: Keep the cover separate from body numbering and omit decorative blank pages.

tables.overflow: Continue on a labeled landscape page or split by logical column group.

callouts.rule: Use labels and borders in addition to color.

diagram_placement.rule: Place after first reference, preserve aspect ratio, and keep source mapping legible.

image_placement.rule: Place beside the claim it supports; crop only non-semantic margins and record provenance.

captions_alt_text.rule: Captions state purpose and source; alt text communicates the decision-relevant content.

headers_footers.footer: Document ID, version, confidentiality, and page number

source_notes.rule: Bind material claims and visuals to stable source notes without exposing secrets or unsupported attribution.

pagination.orphan_control: Keep headings with at least two following body lines and keep captions with their visual.
pagination.overflow_policy: Reflow, split, or use an approved landscape page; never clip text, tables, diagrams, or images.
pagination.empty_page_policy: Remove unintended empty pages and record intentional section separators.
